# Tablet setup always visible, selection panel fixed
### Fixed
- **Tablet setup for tablets that report themselves:** the "Set up and control the tablet" assistant is now always visible (it used to be hidden behind "Set up address and password anyway"). It remembers the tablet address and password separately from the night control, saving the dialog no longer erases them, and "Check" needs no new input. The detected tablet address is suggested.
- **Selection panel on a computer:** the buttons "Slideshow", "Undo" and "Clear" stuck out over the right edge and were cut off; they now wrap.

Update: `cd ~/immich-showcase && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. ☕ [ko-fi.com/frameside](https://ko-fi.com/frameside)
